description: Three separate REST reference pages in round 24 each document their own 'Query Response' schema as a bare {status: String, results: Object array} object with no hits/took/total_hits/max_score fields - fts-rest-advanced's POST /api/pindex/{pindexName}/query, fts-rest-indexing's index-scoped query endpoints, and fts-rest-query's Query Context object (a reduced echo of the full search:search-request-params schema). Each page's own worked examples show the full response envelope (status as an object with total/failed/successful, hits array, total_hits, cost, max_score, took) - so the formal schema definition is thinner than the page's own examples, independently, in three places. This is consistent with the underlying cb-swagger spec's QueryResponse model definition being generated thin everywhere it is reused, not a one-off omission on a single page.
